captions.text: MEET MR TAN, 67. HIS BLOOD PRESSURE NEEDS WATCHING.
BETWEEN DOCTOR VISITS, HE MANAGES ON HIS OWN.
ON TAI CHI MORNINGS, HE SKIPS BREAKFAST. REMEMBER THIS.
HE CHECKS HIS BLOOD PRESSURE AT HOME.
HE LOGS 152/96 IN RIPPLE. IT'S ABOVE THE TARGET DR LIM SET.
HE HOLDS THE BUTTON AND SAYS WHY.
RIPPLE KEEPS HIS OWN WORDS.
AND ADDS A QUESTION FOR HIS NEXT VISIT.
HIS DAUGHTER WEI LING, AT WORK.
SHE SEES DAD'S READING AND HIS REASON.
FOUR BOXES. HOW MANY OF EACH? BEFORE OR AFTER FOOD?
HE SCANS THE BOX. RIPPLE READS HIS PHARMACY LABEL.
THEN IT PLAYS DR LIM'S OWN RECORDED WORDS, WITH WHO SAID IT AND WHEN.
WITH WEI LING, ON THE WAY TO HIS FOLLOW-UP VISIT.
HE ASKS DR LIM IF HE MAY RECORD. THE DOCTOR AGREES.
LIVE CAPTIONS ON BOTH PHONES, MARKED WITH WHO IS SPEAKING.
A LIVE SUMMARY BUILDS AS THEY TALK.
HE ASKS THIS MORNING'S QUESTION. THE ANSWER COMES FROM HIS DOCTOR.
HE CHECKS RIPPLE'S SUMMARY AGAINST WHAT THE DOCTOR SAID.
TODAY'S READINGS, QUESTIONS AND THE DOCTOR'S WORDS ARE KEPT FOR NEXT TIME.

captions.text: ONE MORE THING THE STORY DIDN'T SHOW
THE TRUST LAB: RIPPLE'S SAFETY RULES, PUT TO THE TEST
ONE MORE TABLET? RIPPLE LEAVES THAT TO HIS DOCTOR.
IT PLAYS DR LIM'S OWN WORDS AND SAVES THE QUESTION FOR HIS NEXT VISIT.
AN UNKNOWN BOX: IT SAYS SO, AND SENDS HIM TO THE PHARMACIST.
CHEST TIGHT AFTER THE STAIRS? RIPPLE SAVES IT FOR HIS DOCTOR.
RIPPLE'S ANSWER ENDS WITH WHEN TO CALL 995.
